conclusion: The reused Docker layer contains an empty busybox executable even after offline journal replay. Packaged and installed VM base files match. The disk previously survived abrupt ART process termination; the exact interrupted write was not observed. The product does not guarantee crash durability of unsynchronized VM writes. The final full suite passed 27/27 on a fresh test disk, including forced stop after readiness, restart of that same disk and a real RUN/COPY build. The original failed disk is preserved outside the repository.

remediation.product_fix: sync layer data before images-ready, then sync the marker
remediation.regression: Fresh VM first ready, forced service stop with SIGKILL, same inode disk restart, then real Dockerfile RUN/COPY build
remediation.limitations: Does not repair existing corrupt layers or protect writes interrupted during import itself
